title: DCLab Code: thinking text, turn grades and outcomes captured; page tests in a real Chromium
request: Continue without stopping, and capture, record and store data for training the six models.
plan: Turn on summarized thinking (records held only a signature)
Record the person's grade of each turn and the fate of a session's work
Test the page in a real browser

decisions.why: omitted thinking keeps a signature that teaches nothing; checked live that Haiku and Sonnet return text

decisions.decision: playwright-core pinned to the Chromium R&D already installed
decisions.why: no 300 MB browser download on a nearly full disk

change: config thinking; feedback and outcome records; a Good / Not good link on each finished turn; tests/page.test.js.

findings.defect: the SDK's spend cap is checked only when a turn ends
findings.scenario: a cap of USD 0.05 and one Sonnet turn that cost USD 0.12
findings.cause: maxBudgetUsd stops after the turn, not during it
findings.fix: said in the README: a session can pass its cap by one turn

findings.defect: the session records kept no thinking text, only a signature
findings.scenario: every thinking block in the first live records was empty
findings.cause: the SDK's default display omits thinking
findings.fix: thinking display summarized by default (config thinking)

measurements.name: page tests in headless Chromium
measurements.gate: the regression test fails with the old put() and passes with the fix
measurements.result: with the old put() 1 of 3 failed; with the fix 3 of 3 passed
limits: a fake agent behind the real server

outcome: Each session's thinking text, the person's grades and the work's outcome are recorded, and the page is tested in a real browser.
lessons: Probe a capture setting live before trusting it
A regression test is proven only when it fails on the old code
risks: thinking summaries are Claude's text: silver, evaluation only
